# Pitch Spelling

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:PitchSpelling`](gmeow-PitchSpelling.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PitchSpelling>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

A reified relator binding a frame-relative pitch value, a pitch spelling system, and a spelled name string. [`Note`](gmeow-Note.md) names (C♯4, sargam Ga, Johnston +7) are projections, not canonical pitch values; enharmonic ambiguity is modelled as two co-equal spellings of the same pitch (Principles 4, 9, 11).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:PitchSpelling`](gmeow-PitchSpelling.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
